notes: Budgets are conservative operational guardrails, not hard Production SLAs.
Production-only latency must be measured read-only and recorded in the active stability log.
CI should enforce structural/call-shape contracts; CI must not depend on live Production latency.

pos.active_orders_snapshot.basis: Active snapshot now embeds order_items and order_kitchen_sends into the orders read; remaining client requests are dining tables, orders snapshot, and operator labels. Historical pg_stat_statements identified the removed item/send reads as the dominant repeated POS read family.

pos.cart_availability.basis: Cart availability currently reads order_items and kitchen_sends before warehouse/availability resolution.

pos.active_shift.basis: Production pg_stat_statements shows the canonical active-shift RPC is normally low-latency.

pos.send_to_kitchen.basis: Historical cumulative mean is roughly 0.77s across high call volume; kitchen behavior is frozen and only measured regressions may be optimized.

dashboard.sales_snapshot.basis: Direct 2026-09-28 DB measurements were about 14-98ms for 7-day branch snapshots and about 81ms for all-branch year-to-date.

inventory.ledger.basis: Inventory-ledger reads remain a known historical heavy path and need bounded query shape before tighter targets.

costing.sales_summary.basis: Cumulative pg_stat_statements includes a repeated shape around 1.7s mean and slower diagnostic variants.

costing.raw_material_overview.basis: Cumulative pg_stat_statements includes a repeated shape around 1.25s mean.

closing.shift_day_reads.basis: Closing is operationally critical; budget is intentionally conservative until a repeatable current baseline is recorded.
